title: rubus macrophyllus var. hypoleucus
intro: Rubus macrophyllus var. hypoleucus, commonly known as Korean black raspberry, is a type of plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, valued for its edible fruits and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Korean black raspberry include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of allergies, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins.
